title: How do I cancel my subscription or membership?
short: There are two ways: cancel it yourself on the Lesko Support site, or email Customer Service and they will do it for you and confirm by reply.
steps: Self-serve: go to https://leskosupport.com/account-management and scroll to the bottom of the page — the cancellation instructions are there.
Or email LeskoHelp@gmail.com and ask to cancel. Mary Pacey in Customer Service handles cancellations and will reply to confirm it is done.
Before you cancel, download anything shared with you — Call Sheets, reports, spreadsheets. That material stays yours whether you stay or go.
On the $1 / 5-day trial: cancel before the 5 days are up to avoid the next charge.

steps: Email LeskoHelp@gmail.com with your account email and the charge date and amount.

title: How do I use the AI Grant Researcher?
short: Pick your topic, enter your city and state or ZIP, and hit Run Research Tool. Results build up over several minutes, then you can open each one for contact details or export the whole list.
steps: Open the AI Grant Researcher: https://lesko-help-2.mn.co/spaces/24461105
Select your Topic, then enter your ZIP code or your city and state.
Hit 'Run Research Tool'. Results arrive one or two at a time and a full search can take 10–15 minutes depending on your device and connection.
Click '2: Results' to see what it found in your area.
Hit 'See Details' on any organisation for phone numbers, email addresses, eligibility, funding amounts, and a ready-made outreach message.
Click '3: Export' to download the list to your device as Excel or PDF.
Click 'Clear Report' to run a fresh search for another topic or area.
Want to be taught it live? The AI Workshop runs Fridays, and AI User Skills with Roger runs Wednesdays.

steps: On the login page click 'Forgot password?' and follow the email link.

title: Which app is it and how do I install it?
short: The app is Mighty Networks, not a "Lesko" app — which is why searching the store for Lesko finds nothing. Get it via the QR code in your Personal Settings.
steps: Click your profile picture in the top right, then 'Personal Settings'.
Scroll down and click 'Download the app' — a QR code appears.
Scan the QR code, then use the button for Google Play or the App Store depending on your device.
Log in on your phone with the same email address and password you use on the computer.
Searching the store for 'Lesko' will not find it — the app is called Mighty Networks.

title: Too many emails and notifications
short: Emails and in-app notifications are controlled separately. Emails: unsubscribe at the bottom of the email. Notifications: profile picture → Personal Settings → Notifications.
steps: For emails: scroll to the bottom of any email you don't want and click 'Unsubscribe'. You may need to do this more than once — you can be signed up through more than one list.
For in-app notifications: click your profile picture → 'Personal Settings' → 'Notifications', then choose the levels you want.
On a phone you can also turn notifications off for the app in your phone's own settings.
Notifications cannot be deleted. Clicking one clears its unread dot, but the list stays.
